summary: Prepare to plan and support an ISO 22000 food safety management system and the PECB Lead Implementer exam in this five-day course.
audienceIntro: This course is for professionals who lead, advise on, or maintain food safety management systems and need to apply ISO 22000 requirements in organizational work.
prerequisites: PECB lists a fundamental understanding of food safety concepts, basic knowledge of ISO management system standards, and a general understanding of ISO 22000 and management system implementation principles as the main requirements for participating.
